composition_algorithm: retain all 97 authenticated v0.3 effective rows in exact order, then append v0_4_additional_rows in published order

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before directory identity hashing and before candidate import or process
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: a virtual directory has an empty segment, doubled or trailing separator, backslash, colon, dot or dotdot segment, trailing-dot segment, control byte, non-ASCII byte, or DOS-device segment

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before directory identity hashing and before candidate import or process
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: windows_directory_identity_key is not the exact ASCII-lowercase transform of canonical virtual_directory

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before directory identity hashing and before candidate import or process
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: two byte-distinct virtual directories such as Lib and lib have the same Windows directory identity key

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before directory identity hashing and before candidate import or process
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: directory identity SHA-256 is not the hash of the exact ASCII windows_directory_identity_key preimage with one final LF

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during directory inventory validation
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: directory order is not application index zero followed by strict unsigned-ASCII identity-key order

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during physical directory identity validation
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: two logical search directories resolve to the same FILE_ID_INFO volume-serial-number and file-id pair

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during physical directory identity validation
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: a materialized search directory is a reparse point or its FILE_ID_INFO evidence is missing or malformed

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during DLL binding validation
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: a DLL binding parent identity key, directory index, runtime virtual path, or target SHA-256 differs from the authenticated DLL map and directory inventory
publication uses an API, DLL, file-information-class name, or numeric class other than kernel32 SetFileInformationByHandle FileRenameInfoEx class 22
FileRenameInfoEx flags are not zero or REPLACE_IF_EXISTS or POSIX_SEMANTICS is set
source handle, destination-parent handle, intended final name, access rights, same-volume fact, or UTF-16LE name length differs from the authenticated transaction

v0_4_additional_rows.action_boundary: after diagnostic destination recheck and before the no-replace call linearization point
v0_4_additional_rows.mutation: another actor creates the destination and the publication call overwrites it, reports success, or advances to the published phase
any failed no-replace call is recorded as published, PASS, live, rehearsal, or S0 authority
the publication is retried, a replacement-capable fallback is used, or a new destination name is selected
